title: Design Slack Team Messaging
description: Model workspaces, channels, direct messages, and threaded conversations.

data.text: Design Slack. Users join workspaces, create channels, send messages, and reply in threads. Support direct messages and file sharing.

data.title: Workspace, Channel, and Message
Why ParentMessageId for threads?
data.text: A single Message table with nullable ParentMessageId handles both top-level messages and thread replies. Threads are just messages whose ParentMessageId points to the root.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Channel can be public or private
Message.ParentMessageId enables threads without a separate table
data.takeaway: Slack is a workspace with channels and threaded messages. Threads are recursive messages. Keep it simple with one Message table.
